stock_trade_charges.name: Charges on a stock trade beyond the ₹20 brokerage

facts.text: Equity brokerage on Groww is ₹20 or 0.1% per executed order, whichever is lower, with a minimum of ₹5. Buying and selling are separate orders, so each one is charged.

Selling delivery shares adds a DP charge per sell transaction: ₹3.5 depository fee (₹3.25 for women account holders) plus ₹16.5 Groww fee, with 18% GST on top, which comes to about ₹23.60. Intraday trades have no DP charge.

Government and exchange charges are separate from brokerage. Delivery trades pay STT of 0.1% on buy and sell and stamp duty of 0.015% on buy. Intraday trades pay STT of 0.025% on sell and stamp duty of 0.003% on buy. Exchange transaction charges (NSE 0.00297%, BSE 0.00375%) and the SEBI turnover charge (0.0001%) apply on both sides.
GST of 18% is added on brokerage, DP charges, exchange transaction charges, IPFT, SEBI turnover charges, DDPI charges and auto square-off charges.
Some charges apply only when a specific event happens: DDPI charges are ₹100 + GST, and the system's auto square-off of an open intraday position costs ₹50 per position + GST.
Because the ₹5 minimum brokerage and the DP charge are fixed amounts, they take a larger share of a small trade than of a large one.

SEBI advises investors to insist on a contract note for every trade within 24 hours and to note all charges, fees and brokerage that apply to their account. Groww lists every charge on its pricing page.
